title: Immigration Concerns Disrupted Families' Essential Activities
discussion_signal: The post links immigration concerns to disrupted essential activities and public-life disengagement among immigrant and nonimmigrant families, framing fear as a mechanism that can turn public systems into places of practical non-use.
linked_research_question: How do enforcement concerns alter whether immigrant families use schools, health care, public benefits, and other essential systems?
limits: The post links several related Urban Institute research products
